content: Nystatin is generally well tolerated, even when used for extended periods of therapy. However, some adverse reactions have been reported. Oral irritation and sensitization have been observed in certain cases. Gastrointestinal side effects include diarrhea, with one reported case of bloody diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and general gastrointestinal upset or disturbances. Dermatologic reactions include rash, with urticaria (hives) being reported rarely. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, a severe and potentially life-threatening condition, has been reported very rarely.
